pipeline_eval.break_even_guarantee: Strictly non-negative savings: if compact tokens >= raw tokens, raw output is passed through with 0 tokens inflated.
pipeline_eval.reliability_guarantee: Each fixture declares the critical evidence its visible result must keep; a reduction that drops failure identity or hides the outcome counts as a regression even when it saves more tokens.

mcp_catalog_profile_benchmark.policy: every emitted page must measure at or below its declared budget, traversal must reach every stored tool exactly once, and discovery must name a capability for each representative task

mcp_catalog_ledger_surface.measurement: TokenMeter::count_text over the complete catalog a profile would advertise, as the fixed-context ledger ratifies it
mcp_catalog_ledger_surface.note: This is the ratified budget surface, not the emitted handshake. The default handshake emits level-0 compact representations and measures 671 tokens; see mcp_catalog_profile_benchmark for the per-profile emitted cost.
mcp_catalog_ledger_surface.dispatch_parity: All 37 tools (eager + deferred) remain directly dispatchable in tools/call regardless of active catalog profile.

fixture_comparisons.diagnostic_integrity: Preserved test summary, suite status, and execution duration without passing 100+ lines of pass noise.
Isolated failing test assert locations and stack traces while compacting passing tests; naive truncation drops failure details.
Preserved modified paths, staged files, and untracked entries while eliminating guidance comments.
Retained error code, line/col, and suggestion while collapsing multi-line ASCII art squiggles.
Break-even guard engaged for ripgrep search results; output preserved verbatim without wrapper overhead.
Break-even guard engaged for npm dependency tree; raw output passed through directly.
Break-even guard engaged for cluster pods table; format and columns preserved verbatim.

skill_selection_benchmark.cost_accounting: model-visible skill tokens are counted separately from local routing CPU time; bundled resource cost is measured from the real files
skill_selection_benchmark.known_limitation: every positive fixture is modeled as needing its bundled resources, so the on-demand profile ties the eager profile on tokens here and pays extra turns
